title: 第17章 纪红衫第18章 弹性十足
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
“苏铭，可算把你堵住了！”
一声尖锐呼喊，划破长空。
苏铭抬眸，只见伍昊轩那厮，正站在前方，一脸狰狞。其身旁，立着一位身姿挺拔的青年，面庞冷峻，眼神中透着一股与生俱来的傲慢。
“这位乃是于俊泽师兄，外门正式弟子，来自紫云城于家。聚元境七层的修为，在咱外门那可是顶尖的存在！”
伍昊轩满脸谄媚，在于俊泽身旁极尽讨好之能事，旋即又恶狠狠地看向苏铭，“哼，苏铭，今日有于师兄在此，看你还能如何嚣张！”
苏铭目光平静，手中灵剑微微一颤，剑身嗡鸣，似在呼应主人的战意。他心中暗忖：“伍昊轩，上次放过你，是念在同门一场，可你却不知悔改，竟还搬来救兵。既如此，就休怪我不客气了！”
于俊泽微微仰头，眼神轻蔑地扫过苏铭，鼻孔里轻轻哼出一声：
“你便是苏铭？听闻你在宗内还有些手段，不过在我于俊泽眼里，不过是个跳梁小丑罢了。今日乖乖跪地求饶，兴许本大爷心情一好，还能留你一条小命。”
苏铭嘴角微微上扬，扯出一抹冷笑：
“于俊泽？聚元境七层又如何？莫要以为有点修为，便可以肆意妄为。今日，谁拦我，谁死！”说罢，周身灵力涌动，一股强大的气息自他体内蓬勃散发。
“大言不惭！”于俊泽怒喝一声，“伍昊轩，给我上，先挫挫他的锐气！”
伍昊轩得令，手持一柄短刀，身形如电，朝着苏铭扑了过去，刀光闪烁，带着丝丝寒意。
苏铭眼神一凛，不退反进，手中灵剑划出一道绚丽的弧线，正是斩星剑诀起手式。如今在宗门之外，苏铭可就没有了那么多的顾忌。
刹那间，天空中似有星辰闪烁，一道道剑气纵横交错，朝着伍昊轩席卷而去。
“啊！”伍昊轩发出一声惨叫，他的身体在剑气的冲击下，如断线风筝般倒飞出去，重重地摔在地上，生死不知。
“你……你竟敢杀他！”于俊泽见状，双眼瞬间瞪得滚圆，脸上满是震惊与愤怒，“苏铭，你彻底激怒我了！今日，我定要将你碎尸万段，以泄心头之恨！”
随着于俊泽的怒吼，他周身灵力疯狂涌动，聚元境七层的强大气息毫无保留地释放出来，周围的空气都似乎为之扭曲。
只见他双手快速结印，一个巨大的灵力光球在他掌心凝聚，光球内，电芒闪烁，似蕴含着恐怖无比的力量。
“接我这一招，风元爆！”
于俊泽猛地将灵力光球朝着苏铭砸了过去，光球所过之处，大量的树木被瞬间撕裂！化作粉碎！

苏铭面色凝重，他能感受到这一招的恐怖威力。
当下不敢有丝毫大意，将体内灵力运转到极致，灵剑光芒大盛，他口中念念有词，斩星剑诀的第一式——“星辰坠落”即将施展。
“哼，不自量力！今日，便是你的死期！”于俊泽看着苏铭，眼神中满是杀意。
苏铭深吸一口气，手中灵剑猛地朝着天空一挥，刹那间，天空中无数星辰光芒大盛，一道道星辰之力如长虹贯日般朝着于俊泽的风元爆冲击而去。
“轰！”
一声惊天动地的巨响，星辰之力与风元爆在半空中轰然相撞，强大的能量波动瞬间席卷四周，地面被撕裂出一道道巨大的沟壑，周围的树木在这股力量下瞬间化为齑粉。
烟尘弥漫，苏铭和于俊泽的身影在其中若隐若现……
于俊泽惨遭重创，脸上满是惊恐之色，仿若见鬼一般。
“哼，想跑？没那么容易！”苏铭冷哼，周身灵力翻涌，作势欲追。
可于俊泽这厮竟祭出一张保命符箓，刹那间光芒大盛，符箓裹挟着他，如流星般瞬间消失在天际。苏铭顿足，满脸不甘，眼睁睁看着他遁逃，自己却无能为力，“可恶，这符箓竟如此厉害，让这小子跑了！”
目光一转，苏铭看向那些剩下的小弟，眼中寒芒闪烁，“你们，也别想好过！”
他身形如电，瞬间欺身而上，灵力在掌心凝聚，化作一道道凌厉的掌印，狠狠拍向那些小弟。
“砰砰砰”，一声声闷响传来，那些小弟根本毫无招架之力，纷纷被击飞出去，倒地不起，个个疼得惨叫连连。
苏铭冷哼一声，上前搜身，将他们身上为数不多的灵石、低阶丹药一股脑儿收走。他瞥了眼手中的丹药，满脸嫌弃，“切，就这？还不如我自己炼制的呢，真是辣眼睛。”
嘴上虽这么说，还是将东西收了起来，心里想着，“罢了，以后拿去卖了，多少能换些灵石。”
苏铭深知，于家那可是个庞然大物，于俊泽吃了这么大的亏，于家必定不会善罢甘休，很可能会来找自己的麻烦。
“不行，我必须得更快成为正式弟子。”
content_en:
"Su Ming, I've blocked you!"
A sharp cry pierced the sky.
Su Ming raised his eyes and saw Wu Haoxuan standing in front with a ferocious look on his face. Next to him, stood a tall and straight young man with a stern face and an innate arrogance in his eyes.
"This is Senior Brother Yu Junze, a formal disciple of the outer sect, from the Yu family in Ziyun City. His cultivation level at the seventh level of the Juyuan Realm is top-notch in our outer sect!"
Wu Haoxuan's face was full of flattery, and he tried his best to please Yu Junze. Then he looked at Su Ming fiercely, "Humph, Su Ming, with Senior Brother Yu here today, let's see how arrogant you can be!"
Su Ming's eyes were calm, the spiritual sword in his hand trembled slightly, and the blade buzzed, as if echoing the master's fighting intention. He thought to himself: "Wu Haoxuan, the last time I let you go, it was because I was in the same family, but you didn't repent and even came to rescue me. In this case, don't blame me for being rude!"
Yu Junze raised his head slightly, glanced at Su Ming contemptuously, and hummed softly from his nostrils:
"Are you Su Ming? I heard that you still have some tricks in the sect, but in my eyes, Yu Junze, you are just a clown. Today, I will kneel down and beg for mercy. Maybe if I am in a good mood, I can spare your life."
The corners of Su Ming's mouth raised slightly, and he gave a sneer:
"Yu Junze? What about the seventh level of the Juyuan Realm? Don't think that just because you have some cultivation, you can do whatever you want. Whoever stops me today will die!" After saying that, spiritual power surged around his body, and a powerful aura flourished from his body.
"What a shame!" Yu Junze shouted angrily, "Wu Haoxuan, come on, let me weaken his spirit first!"
Wu Haoxuan received the order, holding a short sword with a body like lightning, and rushed towards Su Ming. The light of the sword flashed with a hint of chill.
Su Ming's eyes flashed, and he advanced instead of retreating. The spiritual sword in his hand drew a gorgeous arc, which was exactly the starting position of the Star-cutting Sword Technique. Now outside the sect, Su Ming no longer has so many scruples.
In an instant, there seemed to be stars twinkling in the sky, and sword energy criss-crossed and swept towards Wu Haoxuan.
"Ah!" Wu Haoxuan let out a scream. Under the impact of the sword energy, his body flew upside down like a kite with a broken string, and fell heavily to the ground. He didn't know whether he was alive or dead.
"You... how dare you kill him!" Upon seeing this, Yu Junze's eyes suddenly widened, his face full of shock and anger, "Su Ming, you have completely angered me! Today, I will cut you into pieces to vent my hatred!"
As Yu Junze roared, the spiritual energy around him surged wildly, and the powerful aura of the seventh level of the Juyuan Realm was released without reservation, and the surrounding air seemed to be distorted.
I saw his hands quickly forming seals, and a huge spiritual light ball condensed in his palm. Inside the light ball, electric light flashed, seeming to contain terrifying power.
"Follow my move, Feng Yuan Explosion!"
Yu Junze suddenly threw the spiritual light ball towards Su Ming. Wherever the light ball passed, a large number of trees were torn apart instantly! Turn into pieces!
Su Ming's face was solemn, and he could feel the terrifying power of this move.
Not daring to be careless at the moment, he used the spiritual power in his body to reach its maximum. The spiritual sword glowed brightly. He muttered words and was about to use the first form of the Star-Severing Sword Technique - "Star Fall".
"Hmph, you are overestimating your capabilities! Today is the day you die!" Yu Junze looked at Su Ming with murderous intent in his eyes.
Su Ming took a deep breath and swung the spiritual sword in his hand towards the sky. In an instant, countless stars in the sky shone brightly, and the power of the stars struck towards Yu Junze's Feng Yuan Explosion like a rainbow piercing the sun.
"Boom!"
With an earth-shaking loud noise, the power of the stars and the wind elemental explosion collided in mid-air. Powerful energy fluctuations swept all around instantly. Huge ravines were torn out on the ground, and the surrounding trees were instantly turned into powder under the force.
The smoke and dust filled the air, and the figures of Su Ming and Yu Junze were looming in it...Yu Junze was severely injured, with a look of horror on his face, as if he had seen a ghost.
"Hmph, you want to run away? It's not that easy!" Su Ming snorted coldly, his spiritual energy surged around him, and he tried to catch up.
But Yu Junze actually offered up a life-saving talisman. In an instant, the light shone brightly. The talisman wrapped around him and disappeared into the sky like a shooting star. Su Ming paused, with a look of reluctance on his face. He watched helplessly as he fled, but he was helpless, "Damn it, this talisman is so powerful that it made this kid run away!"
Turning his gaze, Su Ming looked at the remaining younger brothers, his eyes flashing coldly, "You guys, don't even think about it!"
His figure was like electricity, and he rushed forward in an instant. His spiritual power condensed in his palms, turning into sharp palm prints, and slapped the younger brothers fiercely.
"Bang, bang, bang", a muffled sound came out. The younger brothers were completely helpless and were knocked away one after another. They fell to the ground and screamed in pain.
Su Ming snorted coldly, stepped forward to search them, and took away the few spirit stones and low-level elixirs they had on them. He glanced at the elixir in his hand, with a look of disgust on his face, "Yeah, that's it? It might as well be the one I refined myself. It's really eye-catching."
Even though he said that, he still put the things away, thinking, "That's it, I'll sell it in the future, and I can exchange it for some spiritual stones."
Su Ming knew very well that the Yu family was a behemoth. If Yu Junze suffered such a big loss, the Yu family would not let it go and would probably come to cause trouble for him.
"No, I have to become an official disciple sooner."
